title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Game's Trailer Reveals July 30 Release for 'Super Limit Breaking NEO' DLC
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming on Thursday a trailer for the new "Super Limit Breaking NEO" DLC for Dragon Ball : Sparking! Zero , the new game in the Dragon Ball Z : Budokai Tenkaichi arena fighter franchise , and it reveals that the DLC will launch on July 30. The video previews the new Limit Breaker Journey mode, additional outfits, and new playable characters such as Chi-Chi and alternate versions of Goku, Tien, and Piccolo from the original Dragon Ball anime:

In the new solo mode, Limit Breaker Journey, players select a character to strengthen. Then, they take the character to various destinations to fight and level up. Characters consume stamina when moving, and they will have lower health when starting battles with lower stamina. However, they can also gain more experience from harsher fighting conditions. The mode features "Battle Arts," which provide status enhancements. The character's improved strengths will carry over to the game's other modes.

A free update will also add "Sparking! Boost," a new action activated by consuming a larger amount of Skill Stock, and "Chain Blasts," which allow players to switch in reserve allies to continue attacks after their opponent is blown away.

The DLC will include 33 new characters, over 20 new customizable costumes and super attacks, and four new stages, new Episode Battles for four characters, and more Extra Battles. New characters include King Piccolo, Mercernary Tao, General Blue, Android 8, Nam, Grandpa Gohan, King Vegeta, Pikkon, Mighty Mask, Supreme Kai, Super Saiyan Bardock, Chilled, King Vegeta, Super Android 17, Nuova Shenron, Jaco, Cheelai, Champa, and more.

A separate free update for the game added single player mode Mission 100 on January 26.

The game launched in October 2024 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . The game had a Premium Collector's Edition, a Deluxe Edition, and an Ultimate Edition. These editions allowed customers to play the game three days early.

The Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch versions of the game launched on November 14.
author: ANN

title: Netflix is Streaming a New Live-Action Anime (And You Probably Missed It)
content:
Netflix , in its search for the next big franchise, has understandably dipped its toes into the anime realm. Not only has the streaming service helped to house exclusive anime such as Baki Hanma, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run , and Sakamoto Days , but the platform has also been housing quite a few live-action anime adaptations. One Piece, Avatar: The Last Airbender , and more have seen big success with their live-action series on Netflix, with a recent example potentially falling under the radar for many. Earlier this week, one of the biggest classic anime franchises recently released the first episode of its latest live-action adaptation

Great Teacher Onizuka first premiered as a manga in 1997 by creator Tooru Fujisawa, becoming such a hit that the franchise has garnered several anime adaptations, as well as live-action television shows and feature-length films. This year, a brand new live-action GTO aired in Japan as its first episode arrived on Monday, July 20th. Wasting little time, Netflix has decided to house the premiere episode, promising to house new episodes weekly as the Great Teacher takes the stage every Monday. Despite this being a brand new series, the latest live-action adaptation has brought back a major player to assist in teaching the latest rambunctious class. You can check out the new series by clicking here .

A Grand Return For The Anime Teacher

This latest series will see Takashi Sorimachi return to the live-action role of Eikichi Onizuka, which proves just how much he loves the franchise. For those who might not be familiar, Sorimachi first portrayed the star of GTO all the way back in 1998 with the early live-action take on the anime series. Twenty-eight years following his premiere role with the series, Sorimachi is making a comeback to play an older version of the teacher who is anything but traditional. While the original character was in his early twenties in the source material, this isn’t stopping Takashi from returning as an older delinquent turned educator for the recent series.

For those who have never experienced GTO , we have good news for you. The original 90s anime adaptation is currently available to stream on Crunchyroll, Amazon Prime, and Netflix, meaning you have plenty of outlets to see why the franchise has become anime royalty. The original story that helped propel the series in popularity focuses on main character Eikichi Onizuka as he goes from ex-gang member to beloved teacher, using his hatred for the establishment as a way to force himself forward. Despite having a major anime presence, Great Teacher Onizuka has not created a new anime adaptation in decades since the arrival of the series in the late ’90s.

What do you think of this latest live-action anime adaptation arriving in the West? Leave a comment below and join the conversation now in the ComicBook Forum !

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Streams Official Trailer
content:
Sony Pictures Entertainment began streaming on Thursday a new official trailer for the new live-action reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise . The video features the film's star Austin Abrams as Bryan:

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry, Kali Reis, and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell, Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian, Weapons ) directs the new film.

Constantin Film and PlayStation Productions are producing the new reboot film. Shay Hatten ( John Wick: Chapter 4 , Zack Snyder's Army of the Dead ) co-wrote the screenplay along with Cregger. Constantin's Robert Kulzer, Vertigo Entertainment 's Roy Lee ( Minecraft ), Miri Yoon ( Woman of the Hour ), and PlayStation Productions are producing. Nicole Brown is overseeing the movie. Dariusz Wolski is the director of photography. Sources told The Hollywood Reporter that Cregger's film would "take the title to its horror roots and be more faithful to the initial games."

Sony also released the previous movies in the franchise . Four studios, including Warner Bros. and Netflix , were bidding for the film rights.

This film will be the eighth live-action film in the franchise . The first six films in the franchise opened between 2002 and 2017, and all starred Milla Jovovich.

Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City , the first live-action film reboot in the franchise , opened in the United States in November 2021, and then opened in Japan in January 2022. The film is set in the late 1990s, has a completely original story, and features characters from multiple games in the series. CAPCOM producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi ( Resident Evil 4, Sengoku Basara ) supervised the project.

Resident Evil: Death Island (Japanese title: Biohazard: Death Island ), the latest CG animated film in the franchise , opened in July 2023.

The Strong National Museum of Play in Rochester, New York inducted the 1996 Resident Evil game into the Video Game Hall of Fame in 2024.

The Resident Evil requiem ( Biohazard requiem ) game launched on February 27 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. The game has exceeded 6 million units in cumulative sales worldwide. The game is the fastest to reach the milestone in the Resident Evil series.

title: Exclusive: Titan Manga Licenses LastBoss LoveDeath, The Rabbit Circle
content:
Titan Manga revealed to ANN on Thursday that it will publish the following manga:

Title: LastBoss LoveDeath Author: Yoshikazu Kuwajima, Takahiro Seguchi Release Date: April 6, 2027 Pre-Order: Amazon , Barnes & Noble , Forbidden Planet Summary: High school girls Fūka Nagisa, Julie Yūki and Kanon Amamiya never expected their ordinary lives to end with extraordinary powers. Suddenly gifted incredible abilities, the trio throws themselves into battle against a sinister secret organisation threatening the world.

But becoming heroes isn't as easy as they imagined.

Overpowered by the mysterious enemy, the girls are captured – and rather than destroying them, the organisation recruits them as its newest idol group. Now trapped between the dazzling spotlight and the shadowy schemes of their captors, they must navigate fame, friendship and impossible choices while searching for a way to reclaim their freedom.

Bursting with spectacular battles, colourful characters and unexpected humour, LastBoss LoveDeath delivers an inventive twist on the magical girl genre, combining superhero action with the cut-throat world of idols. Writer Yoshikazu Kuwajima and artist Takahiro Seguchi create an energetic series full of surprising reversals, emotional stakes and stylish artwork that keeps readers guessing until the very last page.

Title: T he Rabbit Circle Author: Sanada Shiro Release Date: April 20, 2027 Pre-Order: Amazon , Barnes & Noble , Forbidden Planet Summary: In a world where humanoid animal hybrids exist, Teddy is a rabbit and grows up in an orphanage for rabbits. He is ostracized for his pale skin, white hair, and red eyes. But suddenly, his world changes.

A letter from his father invites him to live at his mansion along with his many rabbit brothers. Things are different when they show him kindness and love. But something doesn't sit right with Teddy, a familiar feeling obscured by the mirage of affection.

He meets his brother Adelbert who quickly becomes infatuated with Teddy, and all seems well...until his brothers reveal that they are there to one day be eaten by their father.

Angered at the prospect of losing his closest friend and brother, Teddy vows to break out before he and Adelbert can be eaten.

Featuring supernatural elements and a horrifying mystery at its center, The Rabbit Circle is bound to lead you down the rabbit hole.

title: Coyote Vs. Acme Releases Final Trailer For Long-Awaited Theatrical Release
content:
Coyote Vs. Acme has been one of the most talked-about animation/live-action hybrid films in recent memory, and for good reason. Originally, the Warner Bros production was set to hit theaters in 2023, though thanks to decisions made behind-the-scenes, the Will Forte/John Cena picture almost didn’t make its way to the public. The movie was shelved by the entertainment studio, but was luckily picked up by Ketchum Entertainment for a release this summer. In the final trailer for the August release, Coyote Vs. Acme is digging deeper into its premise while sharing that quite a few Looney Tunes are set to make an appearance in the previously canceled film.

For those who might not know the premise of this previously canceled film, Coyote Vs. Acme follows the Coyote as he finds himself suing the Acme Corporation for creating scores of traps that blew up in his face. Thanks to Will Forte’s character, Kevin Avery, Coyote is seizing the opportunity to get money for the pain and suffering he’s undergone while attempting to capture the Roadrunner. While Acme is seemingly willing to settle, with their attorney Buddy Crane, aka John Cena, leading the case, the Coyote turns down one million dollars in the footage, proving he’s playing for keeps. While this might be a movie focusing on the Coyote and Road Runner, the final trailer proves that there are quite a few Looney Tunes set to appear, as you can see below.

The Looney Tunes Are Conquering Theaters

Despite running into some wild roadblocks on its way to theaters with this live-action hybrid, the Looney Tunes don’t seem to be slowing down any time soon. Alongside the upcoming The Cat in the Hat animated film, a new short will focus on Daffy Duck and a rather unique soccer experience in “ Daffy Season .” Earlier this year, the upcoming short played at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, meaning that various reports found their way online regarding the subject matter for the theatrical release. Despite being a Daffy vehicle, both Bugs Bunny and Elmer Fudd are also reportedly set to appear , according to reviews.

While a future Looney Tunes feature-length film hasn’t been confirmed , the franchise is still making new properties all the same. This year saw the release of Looney Tunes Gokko , an anime adaptation that reimagined the cast of the cartoon juggernauts in an entirely new way. With Tubi also seeing massive success thanks to streaming the Looney Tunes library, Warner Bros’s biggest animated stars are still taking the spotlight decades following their original arrival to the screen.

What do you think of this last look at Coyote’s fight against the Acme Corporation? Leave a comment below and join the conversation now in the ComicBook Forum !

title: Shikiso Utsuzawa's 'Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For!' Novels Get TV Anime in 2027
content:
A website opened on Thursday to announce the television anime adaptation of Shikiso Utsuzawa 's Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! ( Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihō Saremashita ) light novel series, slated for debut in 2027. The website also revealed the anime's teaser visual, and main cast and staff members.

The novels' original character designer Pukyunosuke and the manga adaptation's artist Mokuba Matsu both drew illustrations to celebrate the announcement:

The anime will star:

Masumi Tazawa as Eliane

Taku Yashiro as Nigel

Tsukasa Sakurai ( The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. , Golden Time , Little Witch Academia episode animation director) is directing the anime at Tsumugi Akita Anime Lab . Naoki Tozuka ( I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince two seasons, Meiji Gekken: 1874 ) is in charge of series scripts, and Naru Nishikōri ( I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince two seasons, Meiji Gekken: 1874 ) is designing the characters.

Kodansha USA Publishing started releasing Matsu's manga adaptation in English digitally in 2024. The company released the manga's first volume physically on March 31, and will release the third volume on July 28. Kodansha USA describes the story:

Ever since she was a child, Eliane has been the saint and protector of the Kingdom of Belkheim, warding off monsters and ensuring bountiful harvests with her prayers. But when a pretender saint beguiles the foolish prince—to whom she is engaged—into believing she is nothing but a fraud, he calls off the marriage and banishes her from the kingdom. Homeless and penniless but free to chart her own course for the first time in her life, Eliane decides to make for the neighboring kingdom, where she hopes to blend in as a commoner and lead a quiet life…but a chance encounter on the road will totally upend her modest plans.

Utsuzawa launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in June 2020. Kodansha began publishing the light novels with illustrations by Pukyunosuke in January 2021. The seventh volume shipped in Japan in December 2024.

Matsu's manga adaptation debuted April 2021 in Kodansha 's Palcy app. Kodansha will release the manga's 13th compiled book volume on July 30. K MANGA is also publishing the manga in English.

title: Kusunoki's Flunking Her High School Glow-Up Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
DMM Pictures announced on Thursday that Mitsuki Mii 's Kusunoki's Flunking Her High School Glow-Up ( Kusunoki-san wa Kōkō Debut ni Shippai Shite Iru ) manga is getting a television anime adaptation.

The manga will star Yūto Uemura as Keisuke Shizuki and Tomori Kusunoki as Shizuka Kusunoki.

Midori Yui (episode director for Carole & Tuesday , Love Flops , Asteroid in Love ) is directing the anime at Passione and Hayabusa Film , and is also overseeing the series scripts. Koji Haneda ( Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf , The Faraway Paladin ) is the character designer, and Hyadain ( Rent-A-Girlfriend all seasons) is composing the music. Suzune Ishikawa (name romanization not confirmed) is the animation producer.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the original manga in English, and it describes the story:

Keisuke Shizuki and Shizuka Kusunoki are taking high school by storm with their good looks, but they share a dark secret: they were both total outcasts in middle school! While Shizuki has succeeded in making himself over inside and out, clearing the slate of his past life, Kusunoki is still struggling to develop social skills to match her new appearance. She's eager for Shizuki's help, if only he could get over his phobia of pretty girls...

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's sixth volume digitally and physically on May 19.

The manga launched on the comic POOL service in 2022. Ichijinsha will publish the eighth compiled volume in Japan on July 28.

title: The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom Reveals Teaser Visual
content:
The previously announced The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom anime revealed a teaser visual on Thursday. The release date is yet to be announced.

The anime stars:

• Rina Hidaka as Koyou

• Takeo Otsuka as Keiun

• Taito Ban as Shingudamu

• Shoya Chiba as Shiei

Koichiro Kuroda is directing the anime at Studio Elle. Aki Mizuki is handling the series composition, Akira Ono is in charge of the character designs, and Shiho Terada is composing the music. Hozumi Goda is the sound director.

Tohru Himuka writes and illustrates the manga from which the anime is adapted. It began serialization in Kadokawa Shoten’s shojo manga magazine Asuka in January 2018. Seven Seas Entertainment is publishing it in English and they describe the plot as:

A shojo manga tale of medicine, royal intrigue, and romance in a setting inspired by historical China! In the faraway lands of the Moon Flower Kingdom, people have long relied on healing methods shrouded in superstition with dubious results. When the young Prince Keiun goes in search of more reliable remedies, his party is attacked by mysterious assailants, and he ends up witnessing a never-before-seen lifesaving procedure that shocks him to the core. Even more surprising, the one who performs this medical feat is a beautiful, yet slightly odd, teenage girl named Koyou! Just who is this girl, and why is the prince being targeted by assassins? Shadowy conspiracies, medical intrigue, and romance abound in this beautifully illustrated shojo manga! Source: The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom anime Official X (formerly Twitter) , website © Tohru Himuka / KADOKAWA / Gekkakoku Kiiden Production Committee

title: Light Novel 'Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihou saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Shikiso Utsuzawa 's Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihou saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu ( Because I, the True Saint, Was Banished, That Country Is Done For! ) light novel on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Masumi Tazawa ( Rokujouma no Shinryakusha!? ) and Taku Yashiro ( Domestic na Kanojo ) are starring as Eliane and Nigel, respectively.

Staff Director: Tsukasa Sakurai ( Mirai Nikki animation director) Series Composition: Naoki Tozuka ( Tensei shitara Dainana Ouji Datta node, Kimama ni Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu ) Character Design: Naru Nishikori ( Meiji Gekken: 1874 ) Studio: Tsumugi Akita Animation Lab

Utsuzawa began penning the fantasy romance novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in June 2020. Kodansha later acquired the series and began publishing the light novel in print under its K Ranobe Books imprint in February 2021, featuring illustrations by Pukyunosuke . The seventh volume was published in December 2024. The series has 1.5 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Mokuba Matsu began drawing a manga adaptation on the Palcy web service in April 2021. The 12th volume was released on February 27, with the 13th volume scheduled for a July 30 release.

Kodansha began simulpublishing the manga in English on its K Manga service as Because I, the True Saint, Was Banished, That Country Is Done For! . Kodansha USA has also published the volumes digitally since March 2024, and physically as of March 31. The 11th volume was released digitally on May 12.

title: Manga 'Kusunoki-san wa Koukou Debut ni Shippaishiteiru' Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content:
Production company DMM Pictures opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Mitsuki Mii 's Kusunoki-san wa Koukou Debut ni Shippaishiteiru ( Kusunoki's Flunking Her High School Glow-Up ) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.

Voice actors Yuuto Uemura ( Saijo no Osewa ) and Tomori Kusunoki ( Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai ) are starring as Keisuke Shizuki and Shizuka Kusunoki, respectively.

Staff Director, Series Composition: Midori Yui ( Sewayaki Kitsune no Senko-san , Carole & Tuesday episode director) Character Design: Kouji Haneda ( Ookami to Koushinryou: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf ) Music: Hyadain ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) Animation Producer: Suzune Ishikawa Studio: Passione , Hayabusa Film

Mii began serializing the romantic comedy manga on the Pixiv Comic website under the Comic POOL label in October 2022. Ichijinsha published the seventh volume on January 28, with the eighth volume scheduled for release on July 28.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga for English release in October 2023 and published the sixth volume on May 19. The seventh volume is scheduled for release in January 2027.

Synopsis Keisuke Shizuki and Shizuka Kusunoki are taking high school by storm with their good looks, but they share a dark secret: they were both total outcasts in middle school! While Shizuki has succeeded in making himself over inside and out, clearing the slate of his past life, Kusunoki is still struggling to develop social skills to match her new appearance. She's eager for Shizuki's help, if only he could get over his phobia of pretty girls… (Source: Kodansha USA)
